reading.title: Checking a jewelry order
reading.text: Mina checks a jewelry order against the customer's request. The order includes a rigid bangle and a charm bracelet with small decorations. reading.text: Omar is going away for a work meeting. He packs his laptop in a backpack and puts his wallet in an inside pocket.
